name: 14-Nation Red Sea Maritime Defence Coalition
detail: Launched Jul 30, 2026 in Riyadh after 43 of 51 invited states plus the EU convened; 14 signed the founding statement (incl. Turkiye, Egypt, Pakistan, Jordan, Bangladesh) committing naval patrol, intelligence-sharing and joint-exercise assets to protect Bab el-Mandeb, the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. UAE and Oman did not join.

name: PLC-Aligned Ground Forces (Marib Front)
detail: Homeland Shield Forces, Emergency Forces and First Military Region units defending the Marib front, struck heavily on Aug 6, 2026 (30-58 killed) and since reinforced under a National Defense Council readiness order; claimed a counter-offensive success south of Marib on Aug 18.

name: Houthi Ballistic Missile & Loitering Drone Force
detail: Expanded arsenal used across the Aug 2026 campaign — ballistic missiles against Marib, Hadramout, al-Makha, Najran and the Tihamah; loitering drones against the Jazan refinery. US/Saudi officials attribute components and guidance technology to Iranian supply chains, which Iran denies directing operationally.

name: Saudi Air Defense Batteries (Abha, Najran, Jazan)
detail: Saudi/allied air-defense systems credited with intercepting all projectiles in the Jul 13 Abha Airport attack; unable to prevent the Aug 7 Najran and Aug 9 Jazan strikes from reaching their targets, prompting the Kingdom's Aug 7 Mecca Joint Defence Agreement and raised alert posture.

name: Saudi Landing Ship / Disputed Commercial Vessel, Off Mokha
detail: Vessel targeted by Houthi ballistic missiles Aug 17, 2026. Houthis describe it as an active military landing ship with four escorting patrol boats; Yemen's government describes it as a decommissioned commercial ship under maintenance. Status and identity remain disputed.

name: Mecca Joint Defence Agreement — Saudi/Turkey/Pakistan
detail: Signed Aug 7, 2026 by MBS, Erdoğan and Shehbaz Sharif, this mutual-defense pact combines Pakistan's nuclear deterrent, Turkey's military-industrial base and Saudi financial resources into a Sunni-led collective-defense framework, extending the Sep 2025 bilateral Saudi-Pakistan pact.

name: Southern Transitional Council (STC) Forces
detail: Aden-based forces aligned with PLC member Aidarus al-Zoubaidi, holding the southern flank around Aden and Taiz as the Houthi offensive concentrated on Marib, Hadramout and the Red Sea coast in August 2026.

name: US CENTCOM Yemen Overwatch (Post-Rough Rider)
detail: Residual US naval and intelligence overwatch of Yemen and the Bab al-Mandeb approaches following the 2025 Operation Rough Rider air campaign, whose civilian-harm record became public via the Aug 11, 2026 Pentagon review even as the US role in the fresh 2026 Yemen-Saudi fighting remains primarily supportive rather than kinetic.
